summary: Discussion-shard signals: vendor agent platform updates (Anthropic, Google), multiple operator how-tos and sandbox/supply-chain concerns, plus new infra primitives (sandboxes, browser MCPs, agent prototypes). Prioritize verifying vendor changelogs and security incidents. | Official-vendor updates: product launches (Cloudflare Search for Agents, JetBrains Mellum2.1, Mistral releases), security advisories (Claude Code TOCTOU, mem0 leak, Cursor malicious extension), sandbox/infra updates (E2B, Modal), and operator guidance (OpenAI iFood case, Microsoft Foundry checklist). | GitHub OSS snapshot: active mainstream agent platforms (Langfuse, Vercel Agent Browser, Cloudflare Agents, Dify, FastGPT), plus infra primitives for eval, browser automation and agent security. No social/operator field reports in this shard — gap for user_workflow signals. | Package-layer sweep: many new MCP/memory/sandbox/eval packages; a few mainstream vendor extensions (OpenAI, Amazon, Vercel, Grafana). Strong signal for shared agent memory, MCP tooling, agent security/eval primitives. Missing social/user-field reports for operator workflows — packages only snapshot.
